answer: What stops the farm is not the opal alone but the kernel behind it and the knoll that survives every appeal. The cost is time at the bench: 3 seasons plus 400 dye inspections, and time cannot be printed or borrowed. Thrifty seller commission with sellers attestation is what separates a real seller from a rented name — a commission sellers renew after dye audits. A faker would have to earn all three from scratch.
